data.long_meaning: The name Sharwanasya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which is the name of the Hindu god of victory, Kartikeya or Subrahmanyam. This name signifies strength, power, and victory. The name Sharwanasya carries the meaning “God of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwanasya usually hope their child will grow to embody god of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, Sharwanasya is believed to bring blessings of victory, strength, and power to the one who bears this name. It is a name that resonates with the divine energy of the Hindu god of victory.
data.etymology: Sharwanasya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwanasya total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
